title: Predicting ICU Delirium in Critically Ill COVID-19 Patients Using Demographic, Clinical, and Laboratory Admission Data: A Machine Learning Approach.
summary: 426 analyzed ICU patients (213 delirium) from prospective observational study; five classifiers use 112 admission variables and Information Gain; Naive Bayes AUC 0.717 under 10-fold CV. Retrospective record extraction and single-center limits apply.
ai_technology: five ML classifiers train on admission demographic/clinical/lab inputs; Information Gain selects features.
organization: NMS—NOVA Medical School, Faculdade de Ciências Médicas, Universidade NOVA de Lisboa
